intro: An independent guide to established real estate developers active in Netanya, Israel. Discover their backgrounds, areas of activity, and official websites.
introMore: From new towers above the cliffs of Park HaYam to large-scale urban renewal in established neighbourhoods, Netanya is one of the most active residential markets on Israel's coast. This guide introduces some of the companies behind that change in plain language, with a direct link to each developer's official website.
